description: A Researcher (class bonus once per Lap) with a caught Growlithe and Rattata.

you.personality: Greedy: Values cash now over long-term team building; avoids fights it may lose.

sell_team_0.class_bonus: only if you do not also sell a Pokémon that takes it instead

sell_team_2.class_bonus: only if you do not also sell a Pokémon that takes it instead

sell_team_0.instructions: Sell Phase at Start: should `you.team[0]` (Porygon) be sold now? Its facts are in `sell_phase.offers.sell_team_0`. `sale_value_now` (coins from selling it now) and `keep_value` (what keeping it is worth) are separate values, each low, medium or high. `class_bonus` says whether your class adds bonus coins to this sale; a once-per-Lap bonus goes to only one Pokémon per Sell Phase.

criteria.true: Sell it now: you get its sale value now, plus the class bonus if `class_bonus` says so, and you no longer have the Pokémon. If you sell every Pokémon you have, you get a Rescue Starter, which sells for nothing.
criteria.false: Keep it: you keep the Pokémon and can sell it at a later Sell Phase. When `sell_phase.last_sell_phase` is true there is none: a Pokémon kept to the end of the game is sold automatically for less, with no class bonus.
